pairs.subject: embedded-preview
pairs.evidence: app/layout.tsx:70 The only preview-adjacent tool in this context, the DevInspector, mounts inside the host's own React tree and inspects the host's own document, so there is no framed guest app, no guest server and no cross-frame bridge. That makes this the golden path's 'same-origin, first-party' exclusion; a search of app/ and lib/ for targetOrigin and event.origin found nothing, and none of the context's 14 files contains iframe, postMessage or contentWindow.

techniques.evidence: app/_dev-inspector/DevInspector.tsx:167 Listens to DOM events on the host's own document. No message events cross a frame, so there is no origin to validate.

app/_dev-inspector/devInspectorUi.tsx:169 This works like the technique (build-time data-loc stamping, plus a degraded state that says so when stamping is off), but the instrumented code is the host itself, not a guest app, so the precondition does not hold.
app/_dev-inspector/DevInspector.tsx:205 The overlay draws through a React portal into the same document. There is no frame channel and no request/reply to correlate.
